'''Drev''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed aboard the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Drev first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as a vendor on the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
